edges.sentence: In order to improve our running time, we use a hierarchical softmax based on the Huffman coding tree .
Meanwhile, linear classifiers are often considered as strong baselines for text classification problems .

Inspired by the recent work in efficient word representation learning , we show that linear models with a rank constraint and a fast loss approximation can train on a billion words within ten minutes, while achieving performance on par with the state-of-the-art.
